create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running averages of training loss or accuracy values
compute_accuracy_topk: compute top-k classification accuracy from model logits and target labels using the accuracy function
apply_cutout_augmentation: apply the Cutout data augmentation transform to randomly mask rectangular regions of input images
build_cifar10_transforms: build train and validation data transforms for CIFAR-10 with optional Cutout augmentation enabled
save_and_load_model: save a PyTorch model checkpoint or load model state dict from a file path
